description: Carte Schéma directeur vélo is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Gérard TREMEGE. The agglomer TLP by bike Cycling is part of the history of the agglomeration, whether for the sportiest, for cycle tourism or for daily commuting. The Tarbes Lourdes Pyrenees Agglomeration Community is giving itself the means to continue this tradition, like the cycling and active mobility master plan. Coverage: Gérard TREMEGE. The portal shows the English title as "Cycling Master Plan Map" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Gérard TREMEGE. Its keywords include schema-directeur-velo, schema-directeur. The listing shows 1 download or service links in PDF. The listing shows 2023-08-03 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
